steps.say: Open Setup, set every port to SIM and launch. Everything here runs on simulated hardware.
Pick the tip you are cutting with in the Tip list, or press New tip to add one (its ID and model). Every trial is traced to its tip. Press Next when a tip is chosen.
Pick the Sample, then the Chip, then the Flake you are cutting. Register them on the Sample DB first (see Register a sample): Arm refuses without a flake. Press Next when all three are chosen.
Press Arm trial and confirm the prompt (sample vacuum on, stage framed). The station takes a picture of the stage.
Press Capture region and drag a rectangle on the picture of the stage, over the part to watch. Then use it.
The recording is running. Lower the tip, and press Mark force when the force is right.
When the cut is done, press End recording.
Review the trial, add a note if you like, then press Finish trial to keep it.
